node.text: A love letter to Cincinnati❤️ Getting to play for the Bearcats my senior year has been nothing short of a blessing. Playing alongside an amazing group of women and being coached by such a dedicated staff has been the most rewarding experience, and I’m so grateful! #team53

Very sad that we only got one year with you but you played with poise and intensity and you really helped lead the freshman to a brighter future for the bearcats. Good luck to you always! Bearcat forever!❤️
Love, love, love this and you ❤️
